text:
ana: Quick check — where did the meridian-13b converted weights land? I can see a PR but not the S3 path. Need to confirm tensor-parallel layout for Redwood serving (tp=1/2/4) before we run smoke tests.

jing: Uploaded to s3://redwood-weights/meridian/meridian-13b/2026-03-10/converted/ — files are suffixed _shard000.._shard007.safetensors

jing: Layout used: tensor_parallel=2, global_shard_count=8 (TP2 with 4 shards per device). Naming: meridian-13b_shard000.safetensors ... shard007.safetensors

rohit: Tokenizer heads-up: meridian uses SentencePiece with legacy unk id=0 and BOS=<s>. HF conversion left `add_prefix_space=false` which caused decode token offsets in a few eval prompts.

mike: Also noticed config.json in conversion PR sets `"dtype": "fp16"` while Dedicated build expects `bf16` by default. CI unit failing in kv cache dtype assumptions.

nina: failing test snippet:
```
E RuntimeError: expected torch.bfloat16 but got torch.float16
  File "redwood/runtime/kv_cache.py", line 142, in _read_cache
    kv = kv.to(dtype=torch.bfloat16)
```

ana: (typo in name fixed) ana: Can we decide: change runtime to prefer fp16 (less memory on older GPUs) or keep bf16 (preferred for A100/Trn)? Which is lower risk for rollout?

mike: Lower risk is to keep bf16 for Dedicated (A100), but add a fallback fp16 profile for older GPU pools. We can express this in model config via `runtime_profiles` and Redwood will compile accordingly.

jing: I've pushed a small config snippet to the PR — adding runtime_profiles so serving runtime can auto-fallback. Diff: 
```json
"runtime_profiles": {
  "preferred_dtype": "bf16",
  "fallback_dtype": "fp16",
  "tensor_parallel": 2
}
```

rohit: Also pushed tokenizer patch: set `add_prefix_space=true` and regenerated merges/tokenizer.json. That fixes the token offset tests (see small diff in PR).

ana: Great. Can someone run `serve-smoke` with tp=2 and shards=8 and paste logs here? @mike @nina

mike: Kicking off smoke now, will paste results when done.

serving-bot: run serve-smoke meridian-13b tp=2 shards=8 started by mike at 2026-03-10T17:02:34Z

mike: Smoke finished — basic checks: p95 latency 120ms, no OOMs, token-gen correctness sanity passed on short prompts. Attaching last 20 lines of the runtime log: 
```
[17:03:12] INFO compiled kernels for bf16 path
[17:03:13] WARN falling back to fp16 for shard 6 (device memory low)
[17:03:14] INFO kv cache restored for shard000..shard007
[17:03:15] INFO generation sample ok (gold vs pred match)
```

nina: After switching kv cache cast to respect `preferred_dtype` + fallback, unit tests pass locally. Pushed fix in the conversion-utils module.

ana: I'll do the final QA pass and merge the conversion PR if CI is green. Anyone object to the runtime_profiles approach?

rohit: No objections. Please ensure the model card notes the tokenizer change (add_prefix_space) so downstream reranks don't break.

mike: I'll update the doc snippet in the PR and add a small eval prompt set for regression monitoring.

serving-bot: CI: conversion-pr #482 — checks passed (unit, smoke) at 2026-03-10T17:24:01Z

ana: Awesome. Thanks all :rocket: :thumbsup: 

ana: Action items: merge PR, tag model version v1.0.1-serve, add runtime_profile to onboarding checklist, and add tokenizer note to model card.

jing: +1, will push final tag after merge.

mike: will add eval alerts to Optimize.

nina: will create a short postmortem note in case fallback fires in prod.

ana: closing thread — feel free to reopen if anything pops up.
